Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. ClearPay's security team is collecting artifacts for our April SIG review and the upcoming SOC 2 binder. We need the following from Redwood to complete our assessment:

- Latest Incident Response Plan (IRP) and runbook that applies to auth/credential events (redacted OK)
- SIG v2 responses for the Security Incident Management section (spreadsheet-friendly)
- A short incident summary and postmortem for the March 12 auth-related customer support escalation you referenced during the call (sanitized is fine)
- A small sample of telemetry/redacted logs demonstrating detection and containment steps (no PII)

Can you share an estimated delivery window and whether anything needs an exception or NDA? Ideally we'd have items 1–3 by next Tuesday (2026-03-30) so we can circulate internally.

Appreciate it — Andrea

Thanks Vanessa — this timing works. Quick answers:

- Please redact internal hostnames and replace customer names with <REDACTED_CUSTOMER>. We can accept environment tags (prod, staging) but not vendor-specific customer IDs.
- TXT is fine for the telemetry sample; CSV preferable if the fields are tabular.
- Yes, a signed attestation from Marissa would be great. We'll include it in our SIG package.

We don't need an additional NDA for the redacted artifacts, but we will treat raw logs as sensitive on our side. No SLA exception required.

Could you also include a single-line high-level classification in the postmortem (e.g., "user credential compromise leading to limited support access; mitigated via rotation and detection rules"), that helps our reviewers triage.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Andrea
